snapshot_scope: Live connected GitHub affiliation snapshot; only public repository identities and content are stored in this public registry. Private repository identity/content is withheld pending an approved private destination.

enumeration.latest_update_metadata: For this batch and auxiliary public reads, pushed_at/updated_at were fetched from the public repository API. Other repositories retain null unless a prior timestamp exists.
enumeration.limitation: This is a point-in-time access snapshot, not a claim about all GitHub repositories. Private repository names, paths, hashes and content are intentionally excluded from this public file.

private_scope.next_action: Keep private repository inventory in an approved private destination; do not publish private identifiers or content.

scan_cursor.cursor_rule: Scan about 10 repositories per cycle, prioritize direct relevance, and advance only when the dated batch report is written. Private identities remain in the private-access gap, not in this public registry.
